mechanism: Methadone may induce hepatic metabolism and increase vitamin K metabolism, potentially reducing anticoagulant effect if patient is concurrently on warfarin or other vitamin K antagonists.
action: If patient requires concurrent methadone and warfarin/vitamin K antagonists, monitor INR closely and adjust anticoagulant dosing as needed; direct consideration of vitamin K supplementation is not contraindicated but warrants INR monitoring.
